items.title: What's on This Page
items.why:
The screens for kid mode, from your picks on the last page: 5 moves (push-ups, curl-ups, squats, plank, star jumps), body weight only, one round of about 10 minutes, a star for each finished move, prizes from a list, the app's own lock for grown-ups, only kid mode on his tablet, tips read aloud, and the safety line.

Every picture is a mock-up drawn inside the real app on a 393 x 852 screen. Nothing is built.

items.title: Lennon's Home Screen
items.why: What he sees when he opens the app. The Grown-ups link asks for the passcode.

items.title: Each Move
items.why: One move per screen: the picture, how many, the tip, and the safety line.

options.label: Tap the circle for each one
options.desc: He counts out loud by tapping. The star comes at 8. Easy to get distracted by the tapping.

options.label: A big star screen
options.desc: A short beep and a big star, then a button for the next move.

options.label: A small +1, straight on
options.desc: The star fills in at the top and the next move shows at once.

items.title: Stars to a Dragon Ball
items.why: You picked one Dragon Ball per workout when it was 4 moves. With star jumps it's 5 moves, so 5 stars.

options.label: 5 stars = 1 Dragon Ball
options.desc: Still one per finished workout. A wish about every 2 to 3 weeks.

options.label: 4 stars = 1 Dragon Ball
options.desc: Leftover stars count toward the next one.

items.title: Finding a Dragon Ball
items.why: At the end of a workout.

options.label: Celebration
options.desc: Goku cheering, the new ball big.

items.title: All Seven
items.why: Shenron appears with the prize a grown-up picked. Collect Again scatters the balls; a grown-up then picks the next prize.

items.title: Picking the Prize
items.why: Behind the passcode. The list is my draft; nothing on it is food (AAP).

options.label: Change the list
options.desc: Type the prizes you want in the notes.

items.title: Pictures of the Moves
items.why: Only the full push-up has a drawing today (shown above). Wall push-up, knee push-up, curl-up, squat with no weight, knee plank, plank and star jump have none.

options.label: Add them to a ChatGPT brief
options.desc: Same black-ink style as the other drawings. Until they arrive, the move shows without a picture.

options.label: No pictures in kid mode
options.desc: The tip and the voice only.

items.title: What's Read Aloud
items.why: The tablet's own voice, no internet. Hear It Again repeats it. Sound follows the app's sound setting.

options.label: Name, number and tip
options.desc: "Push-ups. Do 8. Body straight like a board."

items.title: The Passcode on His Tablet
items.why: You picked the app's own lock. That passcode also opens the app, so Lennon can't open it without a grown-up once the tablet stops remembering. Today the longest it remembers is 30 days.

options.label: Remember for 30 days
options.desc: A grown-up types it about once a month. Grown-ups always asks for it.

options.label: Ask every time the app opens

items.title: Publish 2.32.0?
items.why: After your picks I build kid mode, run every check, then publish. Only Lennon's profile changes.
